l.a) Describe the structure of ecosystem. 3 1 1

Ans: Structure of ecosystem:
The structure of an ecosystem can be split into two main components, namely:

Biotic Components and Abiotic Components.
Biotic structure includes plants, animals & microorganisms present in an ecosystem.

These organisms have different nutritional behavior and status in the ecosystem and are
known as Autotrophs (Producers), Heterotrophs (Consumers) & Micro-consumers
(Decomposers) based on how they get their food.

Abiotic components are the non-living component of an ecosystem. It includes air, water,
soil, minerals, sunlight, temperature, nutrients, wind, altitude, turbidity, etc.

b) Write the impact of overutilization of groundwater. 2 4 2

Ans. Impact of overutilization of groundwater.

Over use of groundwater has following effects
1. Lowering of water table:

Excessive use of ground water for drinking, irrigation and domestic purposes has resulted in
rapid depletion of ground water in various regions leading to lowering of water table.

2. Ground subsidence

When ground water withdrawal is greater than its recharge rate, the sediments in the aquifer
become compacted. This is called ground subsidence which may cause damage of buildings,
destroy water supply systems etc.

3. Intrusion of salt water

In coastal area, over exploitation of ground water leads to rapid intrusion of salt water from
